entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A former planeswalker and the current Emperor of Kamigawa, a deadly swordswoman who lost her spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker, childhood friend and sparring partner of the Wanderer.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who ignited the Wanderer's spark by trying to control Kyodai with a Reality Chip prototype.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A kami bonded to the Emperor of Kamigawa, embodied by the kami Himoto and seen as a glowing dragon spirit.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: The Wanderer's mentor, appointed acting Regent of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who hunts Tezzeret with the Wanderer and later asks her to track Jace.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, who goes missing on Duskmourn and is rescued.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Moonfolk who is killed by the Wanderer and asks her to care for her son Nashi.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker recruited to rescue Nashi on Duskmourn.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A resident of Duskmourn who guides then betrays Niko and the Wanderer.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn who appears in the cult's chamber.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker fighting Phyrexian beasts in the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A character fighting with Nissa in the Hunter Maze who is compleated.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor on New Phyrexia against whom the Mirrans fight.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers helping against Bolas and New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Wanderer was trapped and fought in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The Wanderer's home plane.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A haunted plane, the House, where Nashi is held.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A chip prototyped by Tezzeret that left the Wanderer's spark unstable and later stabilized it.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which the Wanderer lost her spark.

events.summary: Around age fourteen, the Wanderer's spark is ignited when Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, leaving her spark unstable.
events.quote: The Chip left her spark unstable, causing the irregularities with her planeswalking ability.

events.summary: The Wanderer is lured to Ravnica and trapped there by the Immortal Sun, fighting the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde.
events.quote: she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde .

events.summary: After Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, the Wanderer stays to help the Gatewatch and survives the battle.
The Wanderer helps Ral Zarek track Tezzeret to his fortress on Alara, where she is knocked unconscious by a gargoyle and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Upon reaching Tezzeret, the Wanderer was knocked unconscious by the lead gargoyle and automatically planeswalked away.

events.summary: The Wanderer returns to Esper, finds Tezzeret's fortress abandoned, and reports it to the guilds on Ravnica.
events.quote: found evidence of an organized abandonment

events.summary: Vivien Reid sees the Wanderer cut down a monster on Ikoria before she planeswalks away.
events.quote: where Vivien Reid saw her cut down a monster before planeswalking away.

events.summary: The Wanderer briefly returns to Kamigawa, meets Kaito, and reconnects with Kyodai thanks to the Reality Chip; she and Kyodai appoint Light-Paws acting Regent.
events.quote: she and the spirit agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

events.summary: On New Phyrexia a planar shield disrupts her spark and she planeswalks away after accompanying Kaito and Nahiri to a Mirran camp.
events.quote: the presence of a "planar shield" seriously disrupted the Wanderer's spark upon arrival

events.summary: In the Hunter Maze she helps Nissa and Lukka fight Phyrexians, returns to see Lukka compleated and buys Nissa time to flee.
events.quote: she returned to see Lukka compleated and bought Nissa time to flee.

events.summary: She finds the Mirran encampment razed to the ground.
events.quote: she discovered it razed to the ground.

events.summary: Returning to Kamigawa, the Wanderer saves Kaito and kills Tamiyo, who begs her to care for Nashi.
events.quote: the Wanderer arrived just in time to save Kaito once again and kill Tamiyo .

events.summary: The Wanderer loses her spark in the Great Desparkening and uses the chance to travel her home plane while Light-Paws rules as regent.
events.quote: The Wanderer lost her spark in the Great Desparkening

events.summary: Ral Zarek asks her to track Jace but she can no longer do so after losing her spark.
events.quote: but she was no longer able to do so after losing her spark.

events.summary: Nashi goes missing; the Wanderer has Kaito gather a rescue party and searches for the door, finding one on Ravnica.
events.quote: The remaining team members entered the plane of Duskmourn .

events.summary: Winter guides Niko and the Wanderer, who follow Kyodai's glimmer through the House.
events.quote: Winter warned Niko and the Wanderer not to step on the moths

events.summary: The Wanderer and Niko rescue Nashi from wickerfolk by exploiting their fear of fire.
events.quote: managed to rescue Nashi and defeat the wickerfolk by exploiting their fear of fire

events.summary: Winter betrays the party, sealing them in the room with the cultists; they are knocked out and tied up, and the Wanderer learns the cult is feeding Tamiyo's echo to Valgavoth.
events.quote: Niko, the Wanderer, and Nashi were captured after a betrayal by Winter

events.summary: Valgavoth manifests and opens a door to Innistrad for Winter; Tyvar and Zimone intervene and the group escapes through Kaito's temporary Omenpath.
events.quote: which the group used to escape.
